body:
I am from Italy and have been consuming wormwood for years and the recipe below is one of the best. I do not exceed 12 floz. per day.
1 bottle vodka
50 g sugar
50 ml anise extract
1 tbsp chopped licorice
1 twig wormwood or 1 fluid ounce wormwood extract
Mix together everything and let sit a few days (4). Strain through a coffee filter. To serve mix 1 part absinthe/vodka mix to 4 parts water, add ice, enjoy.
